evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Spur formation and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, reflecting osteoarthritis of left knee
evidence.Lateral OA: Spur formation and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, reflecting osteoarthritis of left knee
